<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Nursery Crawler](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2672)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

The vibrant elemental energy of the [Plane of Wood](/Planes.aspx?ID=25) imbues even the most rotten of fallen trees, empowering their remains to travel in search of the best locations for the next generation to put down roots. This mono-eyed, rotten stump launches seeds that begin to sprout the moment they're buried, whether in the ground or in a living creature's skin.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 18

**[Recall Knowledge - Plant](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 18

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 16

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/ElementalWood_NurseryCrawler.png" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 3">[Nursery Crawler](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2672)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Small" />
<trait label="Elemental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=57" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=125" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 206

**Perception** +9

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +5, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +9

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +4

**Dex** +3

**Con** +3

**Int** -2

**Wis** +1

**Cha** +0
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 18 

**Fort** +6 

**Ref** +4 

**Will** +12 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 48

</row>

**Immunities**
bleed, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145)

**Weaknesses**
[axes](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=1) 5, [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72) 5

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet, climb 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
root +9,
**Damage** 1d8+4 bludgeoning

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
seed +8 ([range increment 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)),
**Damage** 1d6+3 piercing plus germinate

**Germinate**  ([Plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125)) A creature hit by the nursery crawler's seed Strike must, on its turn, spend an Interact action to remove the seed; any seeds still implanted at the end of the creature's turn begin to sprout, dealing 1d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) and rendering the seeded creature [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3) and [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58). Removing a seed after it's sprouted deals 1d4 piercing damage; removing it before it begins to sprout does no damage. Removed seeds that land in viable soil sprout immediately and grow into new saplings after 1 hour.

</column>
